evidence.source: Strymon Cloudburst User Manual Rev D, 'MIDI Functionality' + 'MIDI Specifications' (mirrored in vault Raw Sources/Cloudburst/)
evidence.lineage: transcribed from vault Wiki/Cloudburst/midi-control.md (verbatim CC table, phase-0 open questions carried below)

notes: On/off convention (vendor): 0 = off, ANY other value (1-127) = on. Tables print 0/127 because controllers send extremes.
Presets: 300 slots (0-299) across 3 banks; send CC0 (bank number) BEFORE EACH PC; always powers up in bank 0. PC0 = Favorite, PC127 = Manual Mode.

UNVERIFIED (phase-0 list): exact Windows port name over USB-C (match rule may need adjusting), whether pedal knob turns echo CCs back (MIDI OUT must be 'SEND CC, OTHER' — live mirroring may stay dark), CC0 value for bank 3 (range says 2, enumeration prints 3).
No SysEx bulk protocol exists for this pedal: presets can only be saved human-in-the-loop (hold footswitch 2 s, then send a PC).
Vendor comms test: send CC102 value 127 with the pedal bypassed -> effect engages, LED turns RED.
Matrix base capture on this pedal: if the pedal does not echo, move a control from the PANE once (our send becomes the known base) before starting a matrix on it.

ensemble.label: Ensemble
ensemble.note: 0 is undocumented — never send it (refuse to send, per vault phase-0 ruling).

mp_level.label: mp Level
mp_level.note: Firmware 1.21+. Manual frames it around LEVEL ADJUST MODE.

engage.label: Engage
engage.note: 0 = bypass, 1-127 = engage. CC102=127 is the vendor comms ping.

footswitch.label: Footswitch
footswitch.note: 0 = release, 1-127 = press. The pedal also SENDS this when you step on it.

expression.label: Expression
expression.note: 0 = heel, 127 = toe. Which KNOB the toe/heel endpoints drive is per-preset (factory: Mix); CC100 does not pick the target.

bank.label: Bank
bank.note: Send bank BEFORE each PC. Manual enumeration prints '3=Bank 3' vs range 0-2 — value for bank 3 is a phase-0 test.

pc_help.label: PC 0-299 via chat/automation (CC0 bank first). PC0=Favorite, PC127=Manual.
